Name: GPU Screen Recorder
Description: Watch the replay buffer, recording and stream from a Stream Deck, and save the buffer with one key.
Author: Zedwil

Actions.Name: Replay
Actions.Tooltip: Whether the replay buffer is running, how long it is and how full. Press to start or stop it.

Actions.Name: Save Replay
Actions.Tooltip: Save the replay buffer, whole or the last few minutes, and show the file it wrote.

Actions.Name: Record
Actions.Tooltip: Start and stop a recording, including one running inside the replay buffer. Shows elapsed time and file size.

Actions.Name: Stream
Actions.Tooltip: Start and stop streaming, with the service and how long it has been live.

Actions.Name: Screenshot
Actions.Tooltip: Take a screenshot of the screen, a region or a window, and show the file it wrote.

Actions.Name: Status
Actions.Tooltip: A read-only readout: what is capturing, from which monitor, at what frame rate, codec and bitrate.
